title: Gemini in Workspace, advanced

body.text: Gemini is deeply embedded in Workspace:
drafting in Gmail/Docs, creating slides in Slides, analyzing in Sheets, summarizing meetings in Meet
— its strength is working with data in your account without copying back and forth.

example: "In Sheets: 'Create a column grading customers A/B/C from purchase amount and frequency' — Gemini writes the formula itself"

title: Cross-app in one command

body.text: The real power is connecting across apps:
reference a Drive file from Gmail, pull Docs data to make slides, summarize emails into a table
— use @ to reference a specific file right in the prompt.

example: "In Slides: 'Create an 8-slide deck from @Q3Report in Drive, formal tone, with charts from the report's numbers'"
